productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Imagine if you could grow dragons… in your very own garden! A fiery fun series for all the family._**

Imagine if you could grow dragons… in your very own garden!  
  
  
  
  
A wonderfully funny and sparky series that is sure to fire up imaginations and make children (and adults!) everywhere wish for a pet dragon of their very own.  
  
  
  
  
You'll never look at a dragonfruit the same way again!

Tracks included:

*   Introduction
*   Starlight, Flicker bright
*   The blue tornado and the not so early worm
*   A present for Lolly
*   Once Upon a Fairy Tale Party
*   Flying dragons, screaming lions and the King of Trouble
*   You did what!?
*   The elephant in the bobble hat
*   Happy Halloween Cloud Boy!
*   Captain Brain and the lightening bolt
*   Eyebrows zero, dragons one
*   If only dragons could talk
*   Buried treasure
*   Daleks don't make tea
*   La ciudad oculta de los dragones
*   Missing pieces
*   Chicken on toast
*   The seed of an idea
*   A slippery customer
*   Telling tales
*   Time to let go
*   Goodbyes and lies
*   Tell it to the heart, cos' the head ain't listening!
*   Destination, panic!
*   No place like home
*   Superheroes shouldn't lie
*   Some grim advice
*   A rare and special creature
*   Undercover
*   Into the rainforest
*   Maximus giganticus
*   Liam's big secret
*   Trust the superhero squad
*   Tinkle tinkle, you little star
*   A diamond is forever
*   Afterwards - and you thought it was all over?

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.
